Narrowing stays per-block discipline — it is at least noisy. Direction (a)'s full bidirectional probe matrix and the enum/member-shape granularity question (#3795) are out of scope; price them separately if (b)'s implementation surfaces the need. Gate addition, accept-set unchanged — within lane discretion. Size/model suggestion: M, opus (derivation logic against spec `safeParse` needs care to avoid false reds on enum arms — the card's own caveat).

## PM claim + dispatch order — R27

Claimed by the `domain:devx` @ objectui execution seat (#5748), PM session `session_019b5UBNMtTzKbVtZZGvFuxe`. Branch: `claude/issue-4971-declared-arm-subset-gate`.

### Direction **(b)**, per triage, and the asymmetry is the reason

⛔ Not (a) — the full bidirectional probe matrix and the enum / member-shape granularity question (#3795) are **out of scope**; price them separately if (b)'s implementation surfaces the need. ⛔ Not (c) — writing the discipline into AGENTS.md relies on the author remembering, which is #3809's tombstone blind spot by the same root cause.

**(b): assert that every declared arm set is a SUBSET of what spec accepts on that key.** One direction only.

⭐ The card's own argument for the asymmetry is what makes this the right cut, and it should go in the test header:

- **Narrowing** (declaring fewer arms than spec accepts) produces **noise** — the gate warns on a legal value. Annoying, and **audible**.
- **Widening** (a fake arm spec rejects) is **silent** — the gate *passes* a value spec would reject. `declared = enforced` inverts, and nothing says so.

#3832 made `type` carry arm arrays, which is what created the widening mode. Before it, narrow-only was the sole failure and it was self-announcing.

### ⭐ The measurement that defines "done" — reproduce mutation ③b

The card ran the discriminating pair. Use it as the acceptance test:

- **③a** — add an `'object'` arm to `element:text_input.defaultValue` (spec rejects it there): the per-block test `text-input-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts` **already reds** today. ⛔ It must **still** red — do not trade per-block coverage for the new gate.
- ⭐ **③b** — add a `'number'` arm to `page:card.title` (spec rejects a numeric title): **856 tests pass, entirely green** today. **After your change this must RED.** That single reading is the card.

The difference between them is only that `text_input` happens to have a per-block test and `page:card` does not — so today the property holds by **per-block discipline**, not by a gate. Closing that is the deliverable.

### ⚠️ The trap triage flagged: false reds on enum arms

Triage's size note calls it out — *"derivation logic against spec `safeParse` needs care to avoid false reds on enum arms"*, and the card's own caveat says enum arms and nested shapes must either be exempted or given their own criterion.

⛔ **Do not let an enum arm read as a fake arm.** Coarse-type probing against a spec schema that accepts only specific members will report the coarse type as rejected, and the arm will look invented when it is correct. Decide the treatment, implement it, and **state it explicitly** — an exemption that is silent is a hole; an exemption that is listed is a scope boundary.

⚠️ And the exemption must be **narrow enough to still catch ③b**. Prove that: your enum handling must not be the reason `page:card.title`'s `'number'` arm slips through.

### Non-vacuity

- ⛔ If the walk finds **zero** declared arms, or zero keys covered, the gate must **FAIL**, not pass. Put the census in the verdict line (keys judged, arms judged, exemptions applied and why).
- Reuse the existing `covered` set and exemption discipline in `registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts` — ⛔ do not fork a second classifier. That is the mistake #4894 is fixing one gate over, and this lane rejected the same shape there tonight.
- Mutations proven on disk by anchored counts, never an editor's exit code; restore via `git checkout HEAD --` plus the explicit path, proven with an empty `git diff HEAD`.

### Scope

The gate addition in `apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts` (or a sibling sharing its `covered` set). ⛔ **Accept-set unchanged** — this card adds an assertion, it does not change what spec accepts or what any registration declares. There are **zero fake arms today** (#3832's five arms were each measured against spec and the renderers), so a red on arrival is a **finding**: report it, do not "fix" a declaration to make your gate green.

Root vitest only (objectui#3378). Exit codes captured by redirect before any pipe. ⚠️ Derive the gate list from `package.json` and `.github/workflows/` rather than from this order.

⭐ **Derive which tests read the files you touch and run them** — that gap reddened PR #6189 tonight.
